caption:
You don't need to carry a balance to build credit.
Paying the statement balance in full each month reports the same good history, and you pay no interest.
Carrying a balance only costs you money.
Who told you otherwise?
first_comment: What credit myth did you believe the longest? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Which credit myth fooled you? Follow @creditscoretruths to bust one every day.

card.headline: Carrying a balance won't raise your score
card.sub: Pay in full. Same history, $0 interest.
